title: Hardcore Adventures DataPack
description: DataPack for uniq loot from bosses from mods aquamirae, adventurez, BOMBD, wetlands
body:
![Hardcore Adv Data logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ea6c22319bd8014a08a907a7bff03eb00a8637f.png)

### Goal
This pack ads some structure spawn changes and uniq loot for bosses from my modpack [Hardcore Adventures](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hardcore-adventure). Bosses from mods [Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae), [Adventurez](https://modrinth.com/mod/adventurez), [BOMBD](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction), [Wetlands](https://modrinth.com/mod/beneath-the-wetlands). So much plans for future...
